title: SICP / What is "Computer Science" ?
summary: An excerpt from Hal Abelson's opening SICP lecture introducing computer science and contrasting declarative and imperative knowledge. He argues that computer science is not really a science and is more like magic or engineering of ideas.
why: Cited in debates over whether computer science is a science, and for Abelson's line that it is neither a science nor about computers.

quote.text: Computer Science is a terrible name for this business. First of all, its not a science.
